name: Mimi
source:
The Demon King's mysterious second-in-command and top general.

When seen on the battlefield, Mimi is often mistaken for a young maiden, giving him the upper hand.

He is known all over as a prodigy.

[From [url=https://reineworks.itch.io/mizari-loves-company]itch.io[/url]]
